propositions: Seeded-defect mutant corpus (runs/e2_mutant_corpus.jsonl) with ≥10 mutants per class and paired controls has been deterministically assembled with mutation operators and golden-tested counting helpers (e2_counting.py) to establish ground-truth detection/FP metrics without LLM labeling circularity.

Pre-registered per-class thresholds (runs/e2_thresholds.json) and run-validity guards (≥0.20 INDETERMINATE cap enforced by emit_baseline) have been designed and unit-tested to measure gate detection power and blocking false-positive rates.

The expensive ~100-run LLM batch baseline (live gate sweep over mutant corpus to produce e2_baseline.json outputs) is permanently rejected on cost and superseded by the standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder (change #798, on main), which accumulates the same detection/FP signal from production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost.

Store-isolation seam (standalone git clone with own .git directory, not linked worktree) is implemented by construction in run_e2_benchmark.py to prevent real .tickets-tracker contamination during mutation testing.

The deterministic half (mutant corpus, thresholds, harness seams, counting helpers, golden tests) is intentionally built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2 and NOT landed on main because the harness runtime purpose exists only to drive the rejected batch.
History-mining for baseline reconstruction is dead because only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist versus ~200 needed after impact_model_version bump stranded historical data.
